text_block_list.text: As March began, the Classic-tier Umamusume threw themselves into their training with even greater zeal.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Bitter Glace has less than a month until her next race. Let's start on a new training menu today.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon, you will increase your aerobic exercise
even further to build up your stamina.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Both of you, please do your best
towards the goal right in front of you.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: "Around this time of year, other Umamusume start making huge leaps in their abilities, too."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...At last, the real battle toward
those girls' dreams is about to begin.
choice_data_list: This is where the trainer has to step up too.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Which is why
the presence of the Three Goddesses is a godsend.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I was skeptical of an AI's support.
I already know the training theory, and if there's
something I don't know, I can just look it up.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, your ideas and observations came from angles I never considered—
not to mention their sheer precision.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: In fact, those girls are showing far greater growth at this stage than we ever expected.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: "Vast amounts of data, and simulation trial counts powered by high-speed computations far beyond the reach of our brains."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...To think that AI support could be
so immensely beneficial to an Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Then, I will head over to the Three Goddesses soon.
I promised to discuss the future with them, after all.
In practice, I can feel the tangible results in <chrname>'s training thanks to the knowledge of the Three Goddesses.
The presence of the Three Goddesses may be becoming indispensable to us.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Really pushed my body today!
Feels like I've gotten one step stronger!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: You've really gone past stoic straight into muscle-brain territory.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Haha! But don't you think Little Cocon is growing stronger every day too?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: "Honestly, I'm so glad Trainer Kashimoto is my trainer. She lets me do whatever I want to do!"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Before I had a Trainer, everyone always told me not to rush ahead all on my own.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I'd get into arguments with guys who couldn't keep up. But Trainer Kashimoto was different—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...More voluntary training today as well,
Bitter Glace?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto... Um, I'm sorry.
I just felt like I wanted to do more...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...Still, this really was just overdoing it, wasn't it? Just like everyone said, it's not the right way to train...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for every Umamusume to be different.
It wouldn't be right for you to try and conform to them either.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'll revise the menu right away. In return,
please don't hesitate to speak up from now on.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: "Rumors say Trainer Kashimoto is harsh, but it's totally the opposite! She watches over us really closely!"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Let's both get great results and make Trainer proud!
Alright, see ya tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...You really are watching over me closely.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yay! 1st place—!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Little Cocon.
I'm sorry for throwing you into joint practice
right after you joined the team.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't really mind that, but...
More importantly, I didn't win at all..."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Winning or losing isn't the issue. What I wanted to see was whether you had the talent—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: And I felt that you had it in you.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"I have potential...?
Even though I placed 6th...?"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Compare yourself to the Umamusume you just ran with.
You are the only one who has already caught their breath."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
It's... really true...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
(You discovered my weapons, and...
you discovered me, too...)

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
(With Trainer Kashimoto, we can definitely win.
No matter how big the race, I know we will...!)
